name: print-social-purple-and-gold-professional-services-post-set
title: Purple and gold professional post set with business photography and Arabic text
whatItIs: A violet portfolio cover with 'Social Media Designs' in white and gold, above a 3x3 grid of purple cards with cut-out businesspeople, laptops and team scenes, gold curved swooshes and Arabic headlines.
whatItMeans: Corporate yet lively; violet and gold suggest premium services.
techniques: Use gold swooshes across purple cards as a brand device.
Show people with laptops as service metaphors.
Put a gradient title on the cover with two fonts.
Keep a consistent header and footer in each post.

vocabulary.definition: A curved golden stroke used as a device.
A title mixing sans and script.
A person photo with the background removed.
